_comment: Copies of the models that sit behind a sign-in, hosted so viewers do not
need an account. filename -> full download URL.
Only files that need an account belong here. Mirroring an open model just
spends bandwidth for no gain - it would download fine from its own home.
These are ownCloud share links: the token is opaque and changes if the file
is deleted and re-uploaded, so after ANY change to the server run:
which checks the size, proves Range/resume works, and refuses links that
point at a private address no viewer could reach.
The installer tries the mirror first and falls back to the original source,
so a broken link here degrades to 'needs an API key', never to a failure.
_deliberately_not_mirrored: gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors is NOT gated - it downloads freely from
Comfy-Org/gemma-4 under Apache 2.0, so mirroring it would spend storage and
bandwidth for nothing. It is a different model from
gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5 above, which is the gated one.
